title: Sprawl Guard ratchet
description:
Measured ceilings for current violations.

The file omits language, ownership, reasons, and configured limits. Checks derive those values
from source classification and policy.

files.description: File LOC ceilings for both source roles.

directories.description: Directory fan-out ceilings for both source roles.

allOf.description: Normalized repository-relative path using forward slash separators.

role.description: Production or test role measured at the file.

max_loc.description: Allowed configured LOC ceiling for an existing violation.

SourceKind.description: Production or test role assigned to an included source file.

oneOf.description: Source file classified as test code.

path.description: Repository-relative directory path. The repository root is `""`.

role.description: Production or test role measured at the directory.

group.title: Language group ID
group.description: Language group measured at this directory.

leaf_files.description: Allowed direct leaf-file ceiling for an existing violation.

RelativePath.description: Normalized repository-relative path using forward slash separators.
